mapper.select: SELECT id, username, display_name, password_hash, status, must_change_password, last_login_at, version, created_at, updated_at FROM platform_user WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT action_code FROM platform_user_action WHERE platform_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY action_code
mapper.update: UPDATE platform_user SET last_login_at = #{at} WHERE id = #{userId}
UPDATE platform_user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, must_change_password = false, updated_at = #{at}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO platform_session (id, user_id, token_hash, issued_at, expires_at, version) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{issuedAt}, #{expiresAt}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS session_id, s.user_id AS user_id, u.username AS username, u.display_name AS display_name, u.must_change_password AS must_change_password, s.expires_at AS expires_at FROM platform_session s JOIN platform_user u ON u.id = s.user_id WHERE s.token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND s.revoked_at IS NULL AND s.expires_at > now() AND u.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE platform_session SET revoked_at = #{at}, revoke_reason = #{reason}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.sql: id, code, name, kind, endpoint, credential_ref, timeout_ms, priority, status, circuit_state, consecutive_failures, opened_until, last_failure_at, last_failure_reason, version, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM guest_verification_channel ORDER BY priority, code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO guest_verification_channel (id, code, name, kind, endpoint, credential_ref, timeout_ms, priority, status, version) VALUES (#{id}, #{code}, #{name}, #{kind}, #{endpoint}, #{credentialRef}, #{timeoutMs}, #{priority}, #{status}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE guest_verification_channel SET name = #{name}, endpoint = #{endpoint}, credential_ref = #{credentialRef}, timeout_ms = #{timeoutMs}, priority = #{priority}, status = #{status}, updated_at = #{at}, version = version + 1 WHERE code = #{code}

UPDATE guest_verification_channel SET circuit_state = 'CLOSED', consecutive_failures = 0, opened_until = NULL, last_failure_reason = #{reason}, updated_at = #{at}, version = version + 1 WHERE code = #{code}
